name: ship-pipeline
description: A spec-driven process for building software with agents. It decides one thing, repeatedly: is this spec specific enough that an agent can execute it without making decisions the owner would have wanted to make? Work goes in increments through seven steps — spec and approve, build with tests first, an independent conformance check, owner review, adversarial spec, drive to green, sign off — or unattended end to end with every decision returned as a proposed design-doc amendment.
